title: Ежемесячник всячины
alt: Any and All Living Things / Nandemo Ikimono げっかん！なんものアニメ
description: A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects. The shorts will stream monthly on various social media services such as Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, as well as on ABEMA. (Source: Anime News Network, edited)

en:
A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects.



The shorts will stream monthly on various social media services such as Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, as well as on ABEMA.



(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
